We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. As a SLED Customer Success Manager (CSM), Public Sector at Vanta you will help manage our most complex, high-valued State Government, Local Government, and Education (SLED) accounts. You will act as a trusted advisor, driving value realization, retention, and growth through strategic planning, executive alignment, and cross-functional collaboration. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. Vanta for Government is Vanta’s AI-powered platform that helps government agencies and vendors protect mission data, manage risk, streamline compliance, and build trust – faster and with less manual work. Vanta’s public sector efforts are growing quickly and this is an exciting opportunity to join a new team dedicated explicitly to public sector sales and customer success. We are looking for a passionate, results-oriented, and collaborative CSM who has a proven track-record of managing high-value public sector accounts, leading to customer satisfaction, renewals, and expansion. What we’re looking for - 10+ years of progressive accounting experience, with leadership experience as a Controller, Assistant Controller, Head of Accounting, Accounting Director, or similar senior accounting role. - Public accounting experience paired with meaningful in-house operating experience at a high-growth technology company. - Strong ownership of accounting operations, including general ledger, AP, AR, consolidations, financial reporting, and close processes. - Deep technical accounting knowledge, including US GAAP and experience applying accounting guidance to complex business transactions. - Experience building scalable accounting systems, processes, policies, and internal controls with a focus on accuracy, timeliness, and scalability. - Audit-readiness experience or strong ability to prep

getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:f7b8700a-0ea.title: Executive Assistant - CEO
getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:f7b8700a-0ea.description: About the Role We are looking for a high-leverage Executive Assistant to act as a strategic right hand to our CEO. This is not a typical administrative position. Beyond handling calendar management and travel coordination in a fast-paced, chaotic environment, you will play an active role in driving operational efficiency. We need a clear-thinking, proactive problem solver who can jump right in without needing hand-holding. You will analyze data, build reports, identify operational gaps, and bring solutions to the table before issues arise. Key Responsibilities 1. Executive Operations & Gatekeeping Act as the primary point of contact and buffer for the CEO, managing internal and external communications with tact and judgment. Maintain complete situational awareness of the CEO’s priorities, deadlines, and ongoing projects. Manage complex, fluid calendars across multiple time zones, adjusting dynamically to continuous travel schedule changes. Handle seamless international travel arrangements, itineraries, and logistics. 2. Data Analysis & Business Intelligence Gather data across departments to create clear, actionable executive reports, dashboards, and presentations. Continuously audit workflows and metrics to identify gaps, inefficiencies, and areas for process improvement. Conduct research and synthesize complex information into quick, digestible briefs for decision-making. 3. Financial & Administrative Support Assist with financial tracking, expense management, budget auditing, and financial reporting. Monitor key financial indicators and track cross-departmental deliverables to ensure projects remain on budget and on schedule. Handle confidential business and financial information with high discretion. Requirements & Qualifications Turnkey Capability: Proven experience as an Executive Assistant, Chief Of Staff, Business Operations Manager, or Strategic Coordinator. You can drop into a fast-moving environment on Day 1 without requiring extensive training. High IQ & Analytical Thinking: Exceptional logic and problem-solving ability. You don't just report data; you understand what the numbers mean and recommend action. Proactive & Autonomous: You anticipate needs before they are voiced and actively look for ways to lighten the CEO's operational load. Chaos Tolerance: High adaptability, mental resilience, and composure in fast-changing, high-pressure environments. Financial Literacy: Comfort with numbers, spreadsheets, financial statements, and basic business finance principles. Time Zone Agility: Willingness and technical setup to work asynchronously and align with the CEO’s shifting global schedule. Tech Savvy: Advanced proficiency in modern workspace tools (e.g., Claude, Notion, Slack, Google Workspace, Excel/Google Sheets, project management platforms).

inspirationcommercegroup-inspiration-com.title: Finance Coordinator
inspirationcommercegroup-inspiration-com.description: About Inspiration Commerce Group (ICG) We’re a team of ~50 people who’ve done 6 acquisitions in 18 months and scaled from $0 to >$100M in revenue. We’re a global group with businesses across the US, UK, and EU. We buy and build companies that help people find and buy the products they love. Our portfolio includes leading fashion marketplaces like Italist http://www.italist.com, HEWI http://www.hardlyeverwornit.com and Verishop https://www.instagram.com/verishop/?hl=en, affiliate marketing platforms like Stylight https://stylight.com and MyBestBrands, B2B technology solutions like Bonsai https://shopbonsai.ca, and niche Marketplaces in the Creator and Construction spaces like Everpress https://everpress.com and DOZR http://www.dozr.com. ABOUT THE ROLE We're looking for someone to join DOZR http://www.dozr.com/ as a Finance Coordinator. DOZR is a two-sided marketplace that helps contractors and DIYers rent the construction equipment they need, where and when they need it. Every rental on DOZR becomes an invoice, a payment, a supplier payout — and occasionally a damage claim. In this role you'll support the day-to-day financial operations that keep the marketplace running: billing customers, collecting payments, paying suppliers and keeping our books clean. Your job is to make sure money moves accurately and on time, in both directions. This is a full-time, remote-first role based in Canada. THINGS YOU'LL WORK ON - Invoicing & Billing: you'll own customer billing end-to-end — generating accurate invoices for rentals (including extensions, overages, fuel and damage charges), issuing credits and adjustments when needed, and resolving billing disputes quickly and fairly. - AR & Collections: you'll run our receivables motion — monitoring aging, chasing down payment by phone and email, coordinating with our sales team on tricky accounts, and keeping DSO moving in the right direction. Construction is an industry of slow payers; your job is to make DOZR the invoice that gets paid first. - AP & Bank Payments: you'll prepare bank payment runs and supplier payouts, help process vendor bills, and make sure the businesses that rent out their equipment through us get paid accurately and on time. Suppliers trust us with million-dollar fleets — paying them reliably is core to that trust. - Sales Commissions: you'll own the monthly commissions process for our sales team — calculating payouts, validating the underlying deal data, resolving questions, and getting everything to payroll on time. - Bookkeeping Support: you'll support month-end close — coding transactions, reconciling accounts and payment processors, and helping with journal entries so we can close fast and trust the numbers. - Insurance Claims: you'll support claims when equipment is damaged or lost — gathering documentation, filing and tracking claims with insurers, and following each one through to recovery. - Automation & Better Systems: you'll embrace technology, modern tooling and AI to automate the repetitive parts of all of the above. We don't want to replace people, but we do want to replace monotonous, manual, repetitive work. ATTITUDES We don't care what your current job title is, how long you've been working, or whether you have a CPA. We do care about you being tightly aligned with our operating principles: - You're competitive and love to win. You're competitive and are always looking for an edge. You have a high bar (some would say "unrealistic") for yourself and those you work with. - You do whatever it takes. You're willing to do what others won't to achieve what others can't. What we're doing is hard. Really hard. Sacrifices are required in the pursuit of greatness, and we're chasing greatness. - Founder-level ownership. If something breaks, you fix it. If there's an opportunity, you chase it. You (and we) never say "that's not my job". - Curiosity with teeth. Responsibilities Own and scale paid acquisition (Google Ads, Meta), managing $150K+ monthly spend Drive full-funnel performance across landing pages, intake, and call center conversion Build and optimize growth systems including testing frameworks, CRM/MarTech, and attribution Improve speed-to-lead and conversion rates in partnership with intake and operations Optimize across paid, organic, and lifecycle channels to maximize lead quality and signed clients Qualifications 8+ years in DTC/performance marketing with proven revenue impact (not just CPL optimization) Hands-on paid media experience building and managing campaigns directly Experience in high-volume, complex funnel environments with strong testing and optimization rigor Familiarity with multi-channel acquisition (paid, SEO, lifecycle) and CRM/MarTech systems Proven leadership experience building and scaling high-performing teams Critical Requirement: Must have personal, hands-on experience (not solely team or agency oversight) building campaigns in Google Ads and Meta. While the CMO will not be expected to actively build campaigns as part of this position, deep subject matter expertise is the most important requirement of this job. Candidates must have executed campaign builds, optimizations, and creative strategy at a high level with six-figure budgets.
